subtitle: Assess ground and air risk with SORA 2.5 and build the safety case behind FAA waivers and EASA authorizations.
description: A practical course on assessing the risk of BVLOS operations and turning the result into a safety case. You work through the ten steps of JARUS SORA 2.5: operational volume, intrinsic and final Ground Risk Class, Air Risk Class, tactical mitigation performance, SAIL, containment and Operational Safety Objectives. Then you learn how to package the evidence for an FAA Part 107 waiver and for an EASA specific category authorization. Each module has a short video lesson, a diagram, written notes and a transcript, and ends with a knowledge check. The capstone gives you an editable Safety Case template and a SORA 2.5 workbook in Excel, and a 50-question final assessment (80% to pass) closes the course. Syllabus mapped to JARUS SORA 2.5, Regulation (EU) 2019/947 and 14 CFR Part 107 waivers. Independent training, not affiliated with or endorsed by any aviation authority.
frameworks:
JARUS SORA 2.5 (Specific Operations Risk Assessment): the ten-step method for ground risk, air risk, SAIL, containment and OSOs
Regulation (EU) 2019/947, Article 11, and EASA predefined risk assessments (PDRA) and standard scenarios (STS)
14 CFR Part 107: waivers of the visual line of sight rule (§107.31) requested through the FAA Aviation Safety Hub
FAA proposed Part 108 (BVLOS permits and certificates), status to be verified before use
learningOutcomes: Explain what a safety case is and choose the right regulatory pathway in the US and the EU
Define the operational volume, ground risk buffer and adjacent area for a BVLOS mission
Calculate the intrinsic and final Ground Risk Class with SORA 2.5 mitigations
Determine the initial and residual Air Risk Class and the tactical mitigation performance requirement
Derive the SAIL and use it as a design tool
Set containment and build an OSO matrix with the right level of evidence
Prepare an FAA waiver package and an EASA authorization dossier with full traceability
Produce a working Safety Case and SORA workbook for your own operation
